user.title: Add a shutter
user.description: Select an existing cover supporting position commands. At each load, the target adopts a valid current position without movement. Target position: 0% fully open, 100% fully closed. Buffer is the minimum difference in percentage points before a changed target sends a command. Adjust both sliders after setup.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure shutter
reconfigure.description: Change the name or select a replacement source. The buffer is retained. On reload, the target adopts a valid current source position; otherwise the saved target is retained. Reconfiguration never moves a shutter. A removed registry source must be selected again explicitly.

error.position_unsupported: This cover does not advertise support for position commands.

abort.already_configured: This cover has already been added.
abort.already_in_progress: This cover is already being configured.
abort.entry_not_found: The configuration entry no longer exists.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The shutter configuration has been updated. No movement was triggered.

init.title: Notifications for suppressed movement
init.description: Choose a phone registered with the Home Assistant Companion App, or disable push notifications. A changed target suppressed by the position/buffer rule always creates an Activity entry. Deactivated Natural Shutter devices still log target changes but never send phone notifications. This option takes effect immediately without reloading or moving the shutter.

error.notification_service_unavailable: Select an available mobile_app notification service or disable notifications.

invalid_percentage.message: Enter a finite value between 0 and 100. Values are rounded to whole percentages.

entry_unloaded.message: This shutter configuration is unloaded. Reload it before changing settings.
